headline: Coverage guard: no current finding
dek: The source is stale. Palimpsest keeps the availability and evidence record visible without publishing retained values as current news.

claims.statement: No current finding is published for Coverage guard because the source status is stale.

method.summary: for each signal with a recorded sample size: robust (MAD) z of the metric and of its denominator, then least-squares metric ~ a + b*denominator over the reference readings and the latest residual scored against reference residuals. CONFIRMED when the departure survives conditioning (>= 0.5 of the raw z and >= 2); COVERAGE_CONFOUNDED when it does not; INCONCLUSIVE when the fit cannot support either call

limitations: Current finding withheld: freshness deadline has passed
A coverage-confounded signal is inconclusive about substantive change, not evidence that no change occurred.
